title: A Comprehensive Survey on Test-Time Adaptation under Distribution Shifts
venue: International Journal of Computer Vision 133, 31–64; preprint first posted 2023
publication_status: Journal article; linked preprint versions differ in date
read_scope: Abstract and taxonomy description; not full survey
locations: Abstract; source linked in the online-TTA survey introduction

limitation: Orientation source; no novelty conclusion inferred from the abstract.

title: In Search of Lost Online Test-Time Adaptation: A Survey
venue: International Journal of Computer Vision 133, 1106–1139; online publication 15 September 2024
read_scope: Abstract, introduction, taxonomy and scope exclusions
method_overlap: Optimization/data/model categories and explicit accuracy, wall-time, FLOPs and memory comparisons.
limitation: Reported efficiency evaluation means adding a runtime table alone is insufficient novelty.

title: Benchmarking Neural Network Robustness to Common Corruptions and Perturbations
read_scope: Abstract and official dataset repository README
locations: Abstract; repository ImageNet-C and CIFAR download/evaluation notes
method_overlap: Standard corruption benchmarks and deterministic stored evaluation data.
limitation: Generated corruption tests do not establish performance on naturally occurring deployment shifts.

title: Moment Matching for Multi-Source Domain Adaptation
read_scope: Dataset description in paper and author dataset page; not full method
method_overlap: Natural visual domains for external validation.
limitation: Full DomainNet and the commonly used DomainNet-126 subset are different protocols and must be named accurately.

title: WILDS: A Benchmark of in-the-Wild Distribution Shifts
read_scope: Official proceedings metadata/abstract and opening dataset examples
locations: Abstract; figure 1; author blog's FMoW/domain/subpopulation examples
method_overlap: Natural domain and subpopulation shifts with dataset-specific evaluation.
limitation: WILDS is a suite of tasks; saying 'evaluate on WILDS' does not specify a reproducible experiment.

title: Learning Adaptive Value of Information for Structured Prediction
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 26
method_overlap: Learned runtime control of feature acquisition by decision value and computation cost.
limitation: Value of information and adaptive acquisition are established principles; no claim of inventing them here.

title: A Survey on Active Feature Acquisition Strategies
read_scope: Title, authors, abstract and introductory problem formulation from PDF
method_overlap: Sequential feature acquisition, stopping and prediction under cost constraints.
limitation: A sequential acquisition controller is not a new general problem formulation.

title: Measure Less, Know More: Self-Supervised Test-Time Feature Acquisition
venue: arXiv:2610.03454v1, 2 October 2026; manuscript carries a NeurIPS 2026 footer, acceptance not independently confirmed
read_scope: Abstract and introductory acquisition formulation from downloaded PDF
method_overlap: ECHO-k selects costly modalities using pretrained representation recovery as label-free feedback.
limitation: Acquiring views without task labels is already studied; proposed distinction must concern adaptation-action benefit.

title: Revisiting Batch Normalization For Practical Domain Adaptation
publication_status: Verified preprint; related 2018 journal extension has a different title and author order and is not merged here
read_scope: Primary arXiv metadata and abstract only
method_overlap: Adapting normalization statistics without gradient updates provides a simple terminal-action baseline.
limitation: The proposed episodic statistics update still needs a declared support/query configuration; the abstract does not specify our exact wrapper.

title: Universal Test-Time Adaptation Through Weight Ensembling, Diversity Weighting, and Prior Correction
venue: WACV 2024; official CVF page lists pages 2555–2565
publication_status: Conference paper; primary CVF metadata used rather than inconsistent secondary pagination
read_scope: Official metadata/abstract and indexed method sections 4.1–4.3
method_overlap: Universal TTA covers nonstationarity, temporal correlation and priors using certainty/diversity weights, source averaging and prediction prior correction.
limitation: A strong fixed-method comparison; these deployment factors alone do not establish a new selection problem.

title: Entropy is not Enough for Test-Time Adaptation: From the Perspective of Disentangled Factors
publication_status: Conference paper; linked arXiv first posted March 2024
read_scope: Primary arXiv abstract, official conference PDF first page and author repository README
method_overlap: Object-destructive transformations supply pseudo-label probability differences for sample selection and weighting alongside entropy.
limitation: Perturbation-derived evidence and entropy unreliability already have a strong predecessor; native computation and biased-task assumptions must be preserved when used as a baseline.

title: WISE-ATTA: When to Ask for Labels in Budgeted Active Test-Time Adaptation
method_overlap: Online budget allocation across adaptation windows.
limitation: Uses queried target labels, unlike the proposed zero-target-label deployment regime.
